result.title: Inference-Time Prior Adaptation for Imbalanced Data Streams under Concept Drift
result.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, accepted to Streaming Continual Learning Workshop at ECMLPKDD 2026
result.summary: Data stream classification under concept drift and class imbalance requires models to adapt continuously while maintaining strong minority-class performance. Many existing approaches rely on active memory management, in- cluding instance removal, memory restructuring, resampling, and synthetic data generation. We present PAI-KNN, a k-nearest neighbor classifier that adapts via inference-time prior adjustment rather than memory modification. PAI-KNN main- tains a simple sliding-window buffer and dynamically adjusts its decision rule using class prior estimates derived from recent observations. Evaluated on a mul- titude of synthetic data streams covering various imbalance and drift scenarios, PAI-KNN achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods, per- forming particularly well under scenarios involving dynamic class imbalance and concept drift. These findings highlight the potential of inference-time adaptation in challenging non-stationary environments and suggest that adaptation in memory- based stream classifiers need not rely exclusively on memory modification.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PAI-KNN：在概念漂移与类别不平衡的数据流上，保持滑动窗口缓冲，用近期观测估计类别先验并在推断时动态调整 kNN 决策规则，而不改动记忆内容，在多种合成流上与现有方法表现相当。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不动记忆、仅按近期观测重估先验并改写决策规则」的推断期适配机制，可能为 LVR 中不改缓存而依近期证据重加权 latent 假设与证据筛选提供思路，是否可迁移仍需核查。
